g.text: Step 1/4 Acquiring incident lifecycle log (UCI id 498 -> terminal-state collapse -> binary labelling)
network unavailable in this environment -> using the bundled synthetic generator (same schema, same failure modes)
missing attributes ........ imputed (median for durations, mode for categories)
priority triad ............ ordinal encoded (priority / impact / urgency)
target labelling .......... y = 1 if reopen_count >= 1 else 0
leakage guard ............. dropped reopen_count, ticket_id, caller_id from features
OK 1,000 terminal tickets ready for feature engineering.
